creator_identity.name: Golden Line
creator_identity.niche: Restaurant delivery operations — customer churn & LTV loss
creator_identity.differentiator: Focus on the hidden LTV loss: customers who don't come back after 2 mistakes. Nobody else talks about this.
creator_identity.mission: Help restaurant owners recognize and understand customer churn patterns driven by repeat service failures.
creator_identity.primary_focus: Customer Retention & LTV Loss (86% churn after 2 mistakes)

primary_segments: Restaurant owners with own delivery operation (not Wolt/Uber-dependent)
Suppliers/packers with own fulfillment (e.g., Vegetable Packaging House)
Online food businesses (produce, groceries) with own CRM + fulfillment
secondary_segments: Wolt/DoorDash restaurants with own fulfillment capability
key_traits: Owns order data end-to-end (CRM, KDS/POS, fulfillment)
Sees refund and churn problem but has no systematic fix
High order volume (100+ orders/day where pain is acute)
pain_points: Losing repeat customers after 2nd bad experience (silent LTV loss)
No visibility of complaint history to kitchen/packer at preparation time
Refund abuse by customers with patterns
Information gap between CS team and fulfillment operations
goals: Systematic complaint handling at packing moment

content_pillars.name: Customer Retention & LTV
content_pillars.description: The hidden math behind losing a customer after their 2nd bad experience. Why restaurants hemorrhage LTV silently without knowing why.
example_angles: Your best customer leaves after one mistake. Your second-best leaves after two. Most restaurants don't know the second one ordered again.
86% churn after 2 mistakes. But you only see refunds.
The real cost isn't the refund — it's that customer never comes back.

content_pillars.name: Restaurant Operations & Kitchen Flow
content_pillars.description: The information gap from CS to kitchen. That critical moment at packing where everything goes right or wrong.
example_angles: Kitchen only sees a ticket number. CS sees the complaint history. Why are they disconnected?
The packer has one moment to save this order. Do they know this customer's last complaint?
Complaint info lives in the manager's head, not on the bon.

posting_platforms.description: Primary platform - highest engagement for SMB audience
Secondary platform - strong restaurant owner presence
Thought leadership, ops directors, franchise owners

platforms.distribution_strategy: Generate once, post across all 4 platforms with format adjustments

production_stack.voiceover: ElevenLabs free tier (paste script → download MP3)

faceless_video_types.visual_content: Screen recording of Golden Line at golden-line.base44.app
CapCut built-in stock library (kitchens, restaurants, order prep)

content_quality_standards.bar: High quantity, NOT AI slop. Would a real restaurant owner stop scrolling for this?
red_flags: Generic restaurant advice (10 ways to improve customer service)
green_flags: One sharp, unexpected insight per video
Directly connects to ICP pain (LTV loss, kitchen visibility)

funnel_strategy.primary_cta: Comment if this happened to you
funnel_strategy.cta_rationale: Comments build social proof, are algo-friendly, and direct DMs are high-intent

platforms.posting_strategy: Engagement-first: primary CTA = 'Comment if this happened to you'. Social proof builds algorithm boost. DMs happen naturally after engagement.

direct_lead_with_data.pattern: Direct + Data-driven (Top performer: 6,037 avg views from 34,635 TikTok analysis)
direct_lead_with_data.example: 86% of customers leave after 2 mistakes. But you only see the refund. You miss the customer who just stopped ordering.
direct_lead_with_data.reading_level: 6th grade (2x more views than complex language)

pov_flip.example: You refunded the order. But that customer never comes back.

contrarian.example: Most restaurants focus on refunds. The real loss is churn.

problem_solution.example: Customers leave silently. Most restaurants never notice.

evolution_log.change: Initial brain created from Golden Line strategy document

tasks: Run /viral:discover --keywords (churn, LTV, repeat customer, customer retention)
Produce 1 video/day (7 total) in CapCut + ElevenLabs
week_1.success_metric: 1+ comment per video = validates pain recognition

tasks: Analyze Week 1 results (which topics/hooks got engagement?)
Decide: continue solo OR hire video producer
If solo: scale to sustainable cadence
If hire: brief producer on brand voice + hook patterns
Observe which pillars/angles drove most comments

targets: All scripts posted (Instagram + TikTok + YouTube + LinkedIn)
First comments from restaurateurs validating pain
Identify resonating pillar (LTV math or ops gap)
First DM inquiries about Golden Line
System learning: topics/angles/hooks ranked by engagement

key_insights: Faceless = no phone camera needed. All tools are free.
High quantity strategy: 5-7 shorts/week > 1 perfect short/month
Comments = signal. Don't obsess over views.
System learns fast. After 4 weeks, /viral:update-brain becomes powerful.
No cold outreach. Content pulls inbound traffic.
Golden Line demo is live at golden-line.base44.app for proof
notes.production_workflow: Batch production: spend 45 min producing all 5-7 scripts on one day, post over week on rotation
notes.content_distribution: Once per day for Instagram + TikTok, 3x/week for YouTube Shorts, 2x/week for LinkedIn
